question: Что такое Sync, concurrency and parallelism и как это работает?
short_answer: Sequential code does one operation after another; concurrency makes progress on multiple tasks; parallelism executes work simultaneously.
junior_answer: Sequential code does one operation after another; concurrency makes progress on multiple tasks; parallelism executes work simultaneously. Async and threads often provide concurrency for I/O waits, while processes can provide parallel execution for CPU-bound Python. Важное ограничение: Concurrency can reduce idle time but adds ordering, cancellation and shared-state concerns; it does not make a single CPU calculation faster by itself.
follow_up_question: Какая типичная ошибка связана с Sync, concurrency and parallelism?
follow_up_answer: Selecting async for CPU-heavy work without moving it off the event loop increases latency for every request.
